content: Directive 2023/970 basics could NOT be read from EUR-Lex (returns empty to WebFetch). From secondary sources: seven Article 9(1) metrics per Trusaic = mean gap, median gap, mean gap in complementary/variable, median gap in complementary/variable, proportion of each sex receiving complementary/variable, proportion of each sex per quartile pay band, gap by category of workers. Art 7 response within 2 months. Art 10 trigger: 5%+ unexplained gap in a category not remedied within 6 months. Thresholds: 250+ annual from 7 Jun 2027; 150-249 every 3 yrs from 7 Jun 2027; 100-149 every 3 yrs from 7 Jun 2031. ALL require EUR-Lex re-verification.
